record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Is the Zariski closure of any set of special points in a Shimura variety a finite union of special subvarieties?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 57 (Y . André-F . Oort [4, 203]). The Zariski-closure of a set of special points is a ﬁnite union of special subvarieties.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Sh}_K(G,X)$ be a Shimura variety associated to a Shimura datum $(G,X)$ and a compact open subgroup $K \subset G(\mathbb{A}_f)$, viewed as a quasi-projective variety over $\mathbb{C}$. A special subvariety of $\mathrm{Sh}_K(G,X)$ is an irreducible component of the image of a Shimura subvariety map $\mathrm{Sh}_{K'}(H,X_H) \to \mathrm{Sh}_K(G,X)$ associated to a Shimura sub-datum $(H,X_H)$ of $(G,X)$, possibly translated by a Hecke correspondence. A special point is a special subvariety of dimension zero; equivalently, it is the image of a point $x \in X$ whose Mumford–Tate group is a torus.

Prove or disprove: for any set $\Sigma$ of special points in $\mathrm{Sh}_K(G,X)$, the Zariski closure of $\Sigma$ is a finite union of special subvarieties.
artifact.status_search_result: The André–Oort conjecture in this generality was proved by J. Pila, A. Shankar and J. Tsimerman (with an appendix by H. Esnault and M. Groechenig), "Canonical Heights on Shimura Varieties and the André–Oort Conjecture" (arXiv:2109.08788, 2021), completing earlier work establishing the conjecture for $\mathcal{A}_g$ and reducing the general case to a height bound proved in that paper.

status_evidence.title: Canonical Heights on Shimura Varieties and the André-Oort Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Pila, Shankar, Tsimerman (with appendix by Esnault–Groechenig) prove the André–Oort conjecture for all Shimura varieties.
status_evidence.claim: The full André–Oort conjecture is proved.

status_evidence.title: André–Oort conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: In September 2021, Pila, Shankar, and Tsimerman announced a proof completing the André–Oort conjecture in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Mathematicians Prove 30-Year-Old André-Oort Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Quanta Magazine reports the resolution of the André–Oort conjecture.
